title: lgr configuration
description: Declarative configuration format for the lgr R package (version 1). See vignette('configuring-lgr', package = 'lgr') and ?lgr::config for the full reference.

version.description: Config schema version. Only version 1 is currently supported.

disable_existing_loggers.description: If true, resets every pre-existing non-root logger not named under `loggers` to its default state before applying this config. Defaults to false. Note that a reset logger gets `propagate: true` and no appenders of its own, so it inherits its ancestors' output -- resetting a logger that was deliberately muted can make it more verbose, not less.

loggers.description: Mapping from logger name ('root', or '/'-separated descendant names) to logger definition.

componentDef.description: An R6 component definition: `class` selects the constructor (optionally `pkg::ClassName`), all other keys are passed as constructor arguments.

class.description: R6 class name to instantiate, e.g. 'AppenderConsole' or 'pkg::ClassName'.

layoutRef.description: A named `layouts` reference, or an inline layout component definition.

appendersField.description: One or more appenders: a name reference, an inline component definition, or a list mixing both.

filtersField.description: One or more filters: a name reference into `filters`, a function-valued spec, or a list mixing both.

oneOf.description: A bare-string reference to a named `filters` component.

ref.description: Name of an existing function to look up (optionally 'pkg::name'). Does not evaluate config-supplied source.

code.description: Inline R source evaluated to a function. Requires `allow_code = TRUE` when loading.

class.description: Logger subclass to instantiate. Defaults to 'Logger'. The root logger cannot be a 'LoggerGlue'.

threshold.description: Minimum log level, e.g. 'info', 'debug', or an integer.

propagate.description: Whether this logger passes events on to the appenders of its ancestors.

exception_handler.description: A function-valued spec for handling errors raised while logging.

oneOf.description: A bare-string reference to an existing function.
